legend: As Intra SUST Programming Contest-2024 is approaching, problem-setters are looking for some easy but interesting problems. So, here is a problem for you. There is an infinite 2D grid. You will start from a coordinate (sx,sy)$$$(s_x,s_y)$$$ and reach a coordinate (tx,ty)$$$(t_x,t_y)$$$, possibly the same coordinate. In one move, you can go left, right, up, or down from your current position. You need to find the minimum number of operations to reach the target coordinate. Sounds too easy, right?
So, here is a constraint for you. You can not move more than k$$$k$$$ times consecutively in the same direction. Can you solve it now?
input: The first line contains an integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤105)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 10^5)$$$ – denoting the number of test cases.
Following t$$$t$$$ lines each contain 5$$$5$$$ integers sx,sy,tx,ty,k(−109≤sx,sy,tx,ty≤109,1≤k≤109)$$$s_x,s_y,t_x,t_y,k (-10^9 \leq s_x,s_y,t_x,t_y \leq 10^9, 1 \leq k \leq 10^9)$$$.
output: Output one integer for each case, the minimum number of moves required.
note: In the first test case, you can move 5$$$5$$$ times left and then 10$$$10$$$ times up to reach the destination.

In the second test case, you can move 5$$$5$$$ times right, then 5$$$5$$$ times up, then 5$$$5$$$ times right, then 5$$$5$$$ times up and so on to reach (56,56)$$$(56,56)$$$ and finally move up to reach (56,57)$$$(56,57)$$$.
In the fourth test case, you don't need to move at all.

legend.ai: 随着 Intra SUST Programming Contest-2024 即将到来，出题人正在寻找一些简单但有趣的问题。因此，这里有一道题目。现在有一个无限大的二维网格。你将从坐标 (sx,sy)$$$(s_x,s_y)$$$ 出发，到达坐标 (tx,ty)$$$(t_x,t_y)$$$，两者也可能是同一个坐标。每次移动时，你可以从当前位置向左、向右、向上或向下移动。你需要求出到达目标坐标所需的最少操作次数。听起来太简单了，对吧？
现在给你一个限制：不能连续向同一个方向移动超过 k$$$k$$$ 次。现在你能解决这道题了吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤105)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 10^5)$$$，表示测试用例的数量。
接下来的 t$$$t$$$ 行，每行包含 5$$$5$$$ 个整数 sx,sy,tx,ty,k(−109≤sx,sy,tx,ty≤109,1≤k≤109)$$$s_x,s_y,t_x,t_y,k (-10^9 \leq s_x,s_y,t_x,t_y \leq 10^9, 1 \leq k \leq 10^9)$$$。

output.ai: 对于每组测试用例，输出一个整数，表示所需的最少移动次数。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，你可以向左移动 5$$$5$$$ 次，再向上移动 10$$$10$$$ 次，即可到达目的地。
在第二个测试用例中，你可以先向右移动 5$$$5$$$ 次，再向上移动 5$$$5$$$ 次，然后向右移动 5$$$5$$$ 次，再向上移动 5$$$5$$$ 次，如此反复即可到达 (56,56)$$$(56,56)$$$，最后再向上移动到 (56,57)$$$(56,57)$$$。
在第四个测试用例中，你不需要移动。
